body: Observation, 14 Nov 2026 (emulator, build 151, VM 108): searching "busta" puts the song BUSTA by ARXMANE as the Top result, ahead of the artist Busta Rhymes (and his songs, listed below). An exact title match beating a famous artist's partial-name match is probably what a stranger does not expect ("busta" meaning Busta Rhymes); N-16's 40 real searches should include short artist-name stems like this one and decide the rule.
